theorem_title: A legal positional policy extracted from finite-horizon forcing
formal_statement:
theorem OAI.Snaky21.force_extract (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (hstart : CanForce N ∅ ∅) :
    ∃ σ : Policy Cell,
      (∀ r M B, σ r M B ∉ M ∧ σ r M B ∉ B) ∧
      ∀ β : ℕ → Cell, LegalRepliesBeforeFinal σ N β ∅ ∅ →
        HasSnaky (playState σ N β ∅ ∅ N).1 ∧
        (playState σ N β ∅ ∅ N).1.card = N ∧
        Disjoint (playState σ N β ∅ ∅ N).1 (playState σ N β ∅ ∅ (N - 1)).2 ∧
        ∀ k, k < N →
          Disjoint (playState σ N β ∅ ∅ k).1 (playState σ N β ∅ ∅ k).2 ∧
          (playState σ N β ∅ ∅ k).2.card = k := by sorry
preamble:
import Definitions.Def_Snaky21Core
open OAI.Snaky21 OAI.SnakyPrototype OAI.SnakyPrototype.OrdinaryStrategy
natural_language_statement: For a positive number N, suppose Maker can force a Snaky target within N further actual claims from the empty board, in the finite-horizon forcing relation. There exists one policy depending only on the remaining budget and the two current ownership sets, legal on every finite input. Against every reply sequence legal before the final round, Maker has a target and exactly N cells after its Nth claim, disjoint from the first N−1 Breaker cells. Before that final claim both ownership sets are disjoint and Breaker has made exactly the recorded number of claims. No Nth Breaker reply is assumed legal.
source: https://github.com/openai/math/blob/adc7f1241b42e322a6451854ab7e4b4c146bf78a/preprints/Snaky-in-21-Maker-moves-September-25-2026/article.pdf; The main theorem strategy argument and its fixed-endpoint reformulation; build/strategy.tex, section One strategy against every continuation.
explanation: At each state and remaining budget the policy selects a witness to the forcing relation, using classical choice. Where no witness exists it selects a cell whose first coordinate exceeds the absolute first coordinates of all owned cells. This makes it globally legal. Induction on the played rounds preserves the forcing relation; an earlier target persists under fresh continuation. At the last round a hypothetical fresh reply suffices to recover the target from the zero-budget relation, so the actual final reply is irrelevant. Separate insertion inductions prove the exact cardinalities and disjointness.
